image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a circular aneroid barometer with a gold/brass metallic casing. The dial face is also gold-toned with black numerical markings and text. It features two main scales: an outer scale for atmospheric pressure (inches of mercury) ranging from roughly 28 to 31, and an inner smaller dial for relative humidity (0-100%). There are weather indicator words ('Rain', 'Change', 'Dry') on the upper half. Two black pointer hands are visible: one long hand for pressure and one shorter hand for humidity. A red needle or marker is also present near the top. The glass cover shows some reflections/glare.
